metadata.ogTitle: Free AI for Business Training Programme | Tabi Academy
metadata.ogDescription: Build faster and work smarter. Our 2-week intensive AI cohort helps female entrepreneurs master automation and innovation. Sign up now!

timeline.heading: Here's Exactly What You're Signing Up For
timeline.description: No surprises, no guesswork. From your first day to graduation and beyond, here's every stage of the experience — so you know exactly what to expect and can show up fully ready.

onboarding.title: Pre-Programme Onboarding
onboarding.description: Get set up, get excited, and arrive ready. You'll receive your welcome pack, participant agreement, full schedule, tool setup guides, and direct access to your cohort community — all before the first session begins.

week1.title: Week 1 · Live Training
week1.description: Four full-day live sessions covering AI fundamentals, design tools, app building, and automation. Every session follows a learn → demo → build → share cycle. You'll leave each day with something tangible.

week2.title: Week 2 · Capstone & Certification
week2.description: Apply everything you've learned to a real business challenge. Build your capstone project, present live to the cohort, and sit your certification exam. This is where it all comes together.

postProgramme.title: Post-Programme · Alumni Community
postProgramme.description: Six months of access to all recordings and materials. Two weeks of dedicated post-programme support. And permanent membership in the Tabi Academy alumni community — a network that keeps giving.

curriculum.heading: Four Days That Change How You Work
curriculum.description: Each day is structured around a core AI capability — and each one builds on the last. By Day 4, you'll have gone from AI foundations to deploying autonomous agents for your business.

day1.title: AI Foundations & Business Strategy
day1.description: Understand what AI tools actually are, how they work, and where they create the most leverage in a business. Map your own biggest challenges to AI solutions. Leave with a strategic AI roadmap for your business.
day1.deliverable: AI opportunity map for your business

day2.title: Design, Branding & Visual Content
day2.description: Use AI design tools to create professional graphics, a complete brand kit, and UI wireframes or mockups. No design experience needed — just your vision.
day2.deliverable: Brand kit + UI mockup or wireframe

day3.title: Build & Publish with AI
day3.description: Build a fully functional landing page or simple application using AI-powered development tools. Publish it live. Walk away with a real URL.
day3.deliverable: Live published landing page or app

day4.title: Automation, AI Agents & Workflows
day4.description: Create an AI agent or automation workflow running a real task for your business. From lead capture to content scheduling — this is where AI works for you, not the other way around.
day4.deliverable: Deployed automation or AI agent workflow

certification.description: Certification isn't handed out. It's earned. To receive your verified AI for Business certificate, you need to show up, do the work, and demonstrate real capability.

attendance.title: 80% Attendance
attendance.detail: Across all 4 live Week 1 sessions — 3 out of 4 days minimum.

assignments.title: Daily Assignments
assignments.detail: Completed and submitted from Days 1–3. They feed directly into your capstone.

capstone.title: Capstone Project
capstone.detail: Full written report + 10-minute live presentation to the panel on Day 9.

exam.title: Certification Exam
exam.detail: 60 minutes, online, on Day 10. Auto-submits at the time limit.

score.title: Combined Score of 70%+
score.detail: Capstone weighted at 60%, exam at 40%. Both must be submitted to qualify.

certificate.subtitle: Certificate of Completion
certificate.description: For successfully completing the AI for Businesses intensive programme and demonstrating applied competency across all four training domains.
certificate.verification: Digitally verified · Issued within 5 business days

retake.title: One free retake included
retake.description: Didn't pass first time? You have 14 days to retake the exam at no extra cost. No pressure — just another shot.

faq.contactMessage: Can't find your answer here? Reach out directly — the team responds within one business day.

items.q: Do I need a technical background?
items.a: No. This programme is designed specifically for business owners and professionals — not developers. If you can use a smartphone and a laptop, you have everything you need to start.
ChatGPT, Canva, Uizard, GitHub, Zapier, and Vercel or Netlify — plus additional platforms introduced per session. Every tool has a free tier. No paid subscriptions are required.

items.q: How many people are in each cohort?
items.a: A maximum of 50 participants per cohort. This isn't a webinar — it's a live, interactive learning environment where the facilitators know your name and your business.

items.q: What if I miss a session?
items.a: Recordings are made available within 24 hours. Missing one session keeps you within the 80% attendance threshold. Missing two or more makes you ineligible for certification. Notify the team in advance if you need to miss a session.
Yes. All sessions are delivered live via Google Meet. You'll need a laptop or desktop, a stable internet connection, a working webcam, and a quiet environment.

items.q: What happens after the programme ends?
items.a: You get two weeks of dedicated post-programme support, six months of access to all recordings and materials, and permanent membership in the Tabi Academy alumni community.

Full refund for cancellations more than 14 days before the start date. 50% refund between 7–14 days. No refund within 7 days or after the programme has commenced. A one-time deferral to the next cohort is available if requested at least 5 days before the start date.

items.q: Can I defer to a future cohort?
items.a: Yes — once. If you notify the team at least 5 days before the programme start date, you can defer your place to the next available cohort.

faq.heading: Common Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about the Tabi Women Network experience.

items.q: Who can attend Tabi Women Network events?
items.a: Attendance is strictly by personal invitation. Each edition is curated specifically for women in executive, senior, founder, or leadership roles across tech, business, and governance. If you have received an invitation, you belong in the room.

Women interested in attending a future edition or hosting one in their city can express interest via our city request form or by reaching out to sophia@tabiproject.com. Curation is intentional, so not every expression of interest will result in an invitation.

Each invitation admits one person only. To maintain the intimacy of the table, we do not allow +1s. However, if you believe another woman should be at the table, you are encouraged to mention her to the host. The team will consider extending a separate invitation.

items.q: Is there a cost to attend?
items.a: Attendance details, including any applicable costs for the curated dining experience, are communicated directly to guests upon confirmation of their invitation.

items.q: What is the policy on arrival time?
items.a: We are building a culture of respect for time. Each event starts exactly at the stated time. Guests are welcomed from 15 minutes before the start, and we ask that you arrive early to settle in before the roundtables begin.

items.q: How do I get Tabi Women Network in my city?
items.a: We are expanding monthly across Africa. If you want us to land in your city next, please use our 'Indicate Interest' form. We prioritize new locations based on where our community demand is strongest.
Every attendee is added to the Tabi Women Network member directory—a living resource designed to help members find collaborators and build real partnerships across borders and sectors.

The core programme and conversations at the table are never recorded to ensure authenticity and vulnerability. What is said at the table stays at the table. We do, however, have a media team available for optional seated interviews during the open networking segment.

items.q: How often does the network meet?
items.a: Editions are held monthly in different cities across Africa. Members are welcome to attend editions in their home city and may be invited to editions in other cities where they have a professional presence.

manifestoQuote.line1: The Tabi Women Network is where
manifestoQuote.quote: "We are building a decentralized ecosystem for African women leaders. No gatekeepers. No fluff. Just the technology, governance, and social capital needed to build global legacies."

mission.label: Mission
mission.heading: Championing Tech Empowerment
mission.body: At the Tabi Empowerment and Educational Foundation (TEEF), we are dedicated to bridging the gender gap in technology through exceptional tech education, pioneering research and development, and the promotion of open-source projects. Our mission is to empower African women with the skills and opportunities needed to thrive in the tech industry, fostering an inclusive and innovative ecosystem. Through our unwavering commitment, we aim to uplift individuals, transform communities, and inspire a future where women lead and excel in technology and innovation.

vision.label: Vision
vision.heading: Our Vision for Tomorrow
vision.body: At the Tabi Empowerment and Educational Foundation (TEEF), our vision is to create a world where African women are at the forefront of technological innovation, leading advancements and making significant contributions to the global tech landscape. We aspire to cultivate an environment where education and opportunity are accessible to all, fostering a diverse and inclusive tech community. By empowering individuals with the tools and knowledge to excel, we aim to drive sustainable development, inspire change, and shape a future where the potential of every woman is fully realized and celebrated.
